title: Using Ratibida pinnata, Monarda fistulosa, and Echinacea purpurea to determine the Effects of Cold Stratification, Plant-derived Smoke and Ash, and Rinsing on the Germination and Growth of Prairie Species
why: Web search 'Ratibida columnifera OR Ratibida pinnata germination gibberellic acid OR potassium nitrate OR smoke OR dormancy'. A Kenyon College student paper (2008) tests plant-derived smoke and ash on R. pinnata germination; the repository page has no abstract and the PDF link (viewcontent.cgi?article=1082&context=bio110papers) failed to open, so the result is unread. Would give a species-level sense_chemical value for R. pinnata.
get: open access PDF on the repository page: https://digital.kenyon.edu/bio110papers/80
queries: web: Ratibida columnifera OR Ratibida pinnata germination gibberellic acid OR potassium nitrate OR smoke OR dormancy
